name: Amazon Web Services
description: Allows continuous monitoring of IAM policies, root MFA, S3 bucket encryption, CloudTrail logging, KMS key rotation, and VPC security groups.

scopes.name: Read Only Access
scopes.description: Permissions to retrieve cloud resource details (S3, EC2, RDS, IAM, KMS).

scopes.name: Security Audit
scopes.description: Access audit logs and security posture findings from AWS Security Hub & GuardDuty.

name: Microsoft Azure
description: Monitors Azure Active Directory conditional access, Defender for Cloud security recommendations, and storage account encryption.

scopes.name: Reader Role
scopes.description: Read-only access to inspect subscriptions and resource group configurations.

scopes.name: Security Reader
scopes.description: Access to Microsoft Defender for Cloud alerts and compliance assessments.

name: Google Cloud Platform
description: Scans Google Cloud IAM bindings, Cloud Storage uniform bucket-level access, Cloud Audit Logs, and VPC firewall rules.

scopes.name: Viewer Role
scopes.description: Permissions to view GCP project resources and IAM policies.

scopes.name: Security Reviewer
scopes.description: Permissions to read Security Command Center findings.

name: DigitalOcean
description: Collects Droplet configuration, Cloud Firewall rules, and Spaces object storage encryption state.

scopes.name: Read Token
scopes.description: Personal access token with read privileges across Droplets, VPCs, and Spaces.

name: Vercel
description: Collects edge deployment environment variables protection, team SSO enforcement, and domain SSL/TLS certificate validity.

scopes.name: Team Member Read
scopes.description: Read access to deployments, team members, and security configurations.

name: Google Workspace
description: Monitors organization-wide 2-Step Verification, suspended user accounts, automated offboarding SLAs, and Google Drive sharing restrictions.

scopes.name: Directory Read
scopes.description: Retrieve users, groups, MFA status, and organizational units.

scopes.name: Reports Audit
scopes.description: Access audit logs for logins, token grants, and drive activity.

name: Okta (IdP)
description: Enforces single sign-on (SSO), adaptive MFA policies, password complexity rules, and automated SCIM provisioning across all corporate apps.

scopes.name: Read Only Admin
scopes.description: Read-only API access to query users, groups, factor policies, and system logs.

name: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
description: Inspects Conditional Access policies, privileged identity assignments, and enterprise application consent settings.

scopes.name: Directory.Read.All
scopes.description: Read directory data and audit sign-in logs.

name: GitHub
description: Verifies branch protection rules, required PR code reviews, blocking force pushes, secret scanning, and automated Dependabot alerts.

scopes.name: repo (read)
scopes.description: Read repository metadata and branch protection rules.

scopes.name: admin:org (read)
scopes.description: Read organization members, 2FA status, and audit log events.

name: GitLab
description: Scans protected branches, merge request approvals, and CI/CD pipeline code quality gates.

scopes.name: read_api
scopes.description: Read-only access to projects, merge requests, and groups.

name: Slack
description: Verifies dedicated incident response channels, enterprise message retention policies, two-factor authentication, and approved app integrations.

scopes.name: channels:read
scopes.description: Inspect public incident response and alerting channels.

scopes.name: team:read
scopes.description: Verify workspace authentication security settings.

name: Jira Software
description: Tracks security vulnerability remediation tickets, change management requests, and SLA resolution tracking.

scopes.name: read:jira-work
scopes.description: Read project boards, issue statuses, and security workflows.

name: Rippling (HRIS)
description: Automates employee onboarding/offboarding tracking, background check verification, and security policy acknowledgment records.

scopes.name: company:read
scopes.description: Query active/terminated employee rosters and department roles.

name: Snyk Vulnerability Scanner
description: Continuously monitors open source dependencies, container images, and IaC templates for Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVEs).

scopes.name: org:read
scopes.description: Read security test results, vulnerability severities, and fix statuses.
